title: 大きな夢を叶えるために

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're in the final stages of preparations. As we all attend to our duties, the topic of what songs to sing comes up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello asks me to be involved in writing lyrics for a certain song she's prepared specially for the concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The students and I set our minds to the task. What lyrics would express what they, as runners, feel for their fans?
